provenance.source: representative engineering estimates grounded in public phone-sensor datasheet ranges
provenance.notes: Representative of a 1/1.3-inch, 50 MP stacked phone sensor with dual conversion gain. No value is a measurement of a specific commercial part; the preset is a documented, internally consistent design point for simulation and validation.
assumptions: pixel pitch, full well, conversion gain, read noise, ADC scale, and gain range are representative values inside published phone-sensor ranges, not vendor measurements of one part
QE curve is a synthetic backside-illuminated silicon estimate peaking near 0.82; it is not digitized from a vendor plot
CFA curves are synthetic overlapping RGGB passbands with representative out-of-band leakage
IR-cut curve is a synthetic blue-glass/interference model with a 650 nm cut-on
fill factor 0.85 and microlens gain 1.15 are engineering assumptions
dark current is specified at the 25 C reference temperature with a 7 K doubling interval
DSNU 0.5 e-, PRNU 0.5 percent, row noise 0.5 e- rms, and the hot-pixel dark multiplier are representative engineering assumptions
auto HCG threshold of 200 e- per pixel is a representative readout crossover
spatial crosstalk is disabled by default; the identity spectral-crosstalk matrix models an ideal CFA with no colour leakage
